verdict.rationale: Snowflake's Cortex Analyst explicitly lets business users ask natural-language questions and get direct answers without writing SQL, grounded against Semantic Views that define business metrics/entities relationships, layered on top of RBAC governance — directly matching the story's 'governed, semantically-grounded' framing. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence validating hallucination/accuracy claims, and no explicit documentation tying Cortex Analyst's answer generation directly to preventing 'hallucinated joins' beyond the semantic model grounding.
